Use when the task names IEC 60870-5-104 / IEC-104 / 104规约, DNP3 / IEEE 1815 / outstation, IEC 61850 / MMS / IED / GOOSE (GOOSE and Sampled Values are NOT supported — MMS reads only), a substation / 变电站 / RTU / SCADA gateway / telecontrol front-end, energy / power / utility SCADA telemetry, or 遥测遥信 / 电力监控. Do NOT use for factory/building/process protocols (OPC-UA, Modbus, S7, BACnet, MQTT …) — those live in the base iaiops server — nor for IT/network gear, Kubernetes, hypervisors, or backups.
